text:
PagerDuty Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU queue growth detected for customer-c-77 on private VPC cluster 'c-77-prod' — sustained enqueue rate 250 req/min, scaling attempts failing. Trigger: autoscaler_failure.high_queue (3123456789)

Ava (oncall): seeing it. queue length ~1.9k, p95 latency spiking. Paging now.

Samir (SRE): attaching quick metrics snapshot — queue backlog broken down by model:
```
model-a: pending 980, avg wait 23s
model-b: pending 640, avg wait 18s
embedding-small: pending 310, avg wait 12s
overall enqueue: 245 req/min, dequeue: 40 req/min
```
Looks like provisioner not creating nodes. Autoscaler logs show repeated rejections.

Priya (Platform): grabbing autoscaler logs from the control plane:
```
2026-03-15T09:46:12Z controller: desired=12 current=6 max=12
2026-03-15T09:46:46Z provisioner: attemptCreateNode -> failed: quotaExceeded
2026-03-15T09:47:10Z provisioner: attemptCreateNode -> failed: imagePull backoff for kubelet-agent
2026-03-15T09:47:33Z controller: scale_rejected reason=node_affinity_conflict
```
The private cluster uses a customer-provided image registry with IP allowlist. We're seeing image pull failures for the autoscaler bootstrap image; that causes node init to hang and autoscaler thinks nodes are provisioning but never become Ready.

Jordan (Infra): confirmed from on-host logs: kubelet is stuck at CRI pulling init image; repeated TLS handshake failures to registry. Also customer's VPC has tight egress NAT sessions and we hit ephemeral port limits which slows image downloads to the point of timeout.

Ava (oncall): so two compounding issues: image pull/TLS to customer registry + NAT port exhaustion causing slow pulls. Autoscaler then hits its in-flight provisioning limit and refuses further attempts. Customer impact: all new inference requests queue.

Customer Support: I've opened a ticket with the customer to ask if they changed registry access rules. They report no recent changes but acked that their NAT gateway has been under heavy load earlier today.

Samir (SRE): mitigation plan — immediate and next steps:
1) Short-term (10-30m): reduce backlog by routing new requests to hosted fallbacks for that customer and enable per-customer throttle to 30qps to allow backlog to drain.
2) Mid-term (30-90m): temporarily bump autoscaler max_inflight_provisioning for this cluster and increase max_nodes to allow manual node creation while we fix image pulls.
3) Long-term: work with customer on improving registry egress and provide mirror option in our private registry cache.

Priya (Platform): executing step 1 now: updating routing policy for customer-c-77 to prefer-hosted with fallback true. Pushing config:
```
POST /routing/policies/c-77 -> {"preference":"hosted","fallback":true}
```
Should start diverting new requests within ~20s.

Jordan (Infra): I'm going to manually create two nodes from a cached node image (no external registry pull) to get capacity quick. Commands:
```
# create node from local image snap
infractl node create --cluster c-77-prod --image local-node-snap:v1 --labels "gpu=true,temp-pool"
```
Executing...

Ava (oncall): also notify oncall-mobile team, handing up to night shift in 30m after stabilization. Annotate runbook steps.

PagerDuty Bot: @Ava (oncall) acknowledged incident, escalation policy: infra-sre -> platform -> eng-cto.

Samir (SRE): autoscaler config looked like this snippet:
```
autoscaler:
  max_inflight_provisioning: 6
  max_nodes: 12
  scale_cooldown: 60s
  node_boot_timeout: 600s
```
We hit max_inflight_provisioning and the controller refused further attempts. I propose bumping max_inflight_provisioning to 20 and temporarily max_nodes to 24. Will also reduce node_boot_timeout to 420s for faster failover detection.

Priya (Platform): making change to cluster config now (PATCH). Will monitor for side effects.

Jordan (Infra): manual nodes created and joined - two nodes Ready in ~5m using local snapshot. Queue drained ~8% after their join.

Samir (SRE): routing change took effect — inbound requests to customer-c-77 show ~65% served by hosted fallback now. Backlog growth rate flattened.

Customer Support: customer reports partial functionality restored for some endpoints; they still see degraded throughput for large-model requests. Marking SEV2.

Ava (oncall): customer impact assessment: impact=degraded; affected endpoints: generation (large), embeddings for batch jobs delayed; estimated affected users ~1200 active sessions; SLA risk moderate. Updating status page with interim message.

Samir (SRE): continuing troubleshooting on image pull/TLS. Captured tcpdump from node init showing TLS errors: "remote error: tls: handshake failure" and server cert CN mismatch. Suspect customer's registry rotated certs without updating allowlist/certs on nodes. We'll hand as follow-up to platform/customer.

Jordan (Infra): NAT port exhaustion metric shows 95% usage on customer's NAT gateway; recommend customer increase port range or deploy NAT gateway scaling. Sent prescriptive guidance DM to Customer Support to relay.

Priya (Platform): autoscaler config patch applied: max_inflight_provisioning=20 max_nodes=24 node_boot_timeout=420s. Observing a few more attempted provisions, some failing due to imagepull but now autoscaler continues trying.

Ava (oncall): handing incident to night team at 3123457200 with context: manual nodes added; routing fallback in place; autoscaler config bumped; next actions: coordinate with customer to fix registry certs and NAT, add mirror image in our cache, revert temporary autoscaler limits after stabilization.

Jordan (Infra): leaving command notes for night: how to recreate local node image, how to add snapshots, how to revert autoscaler changes.

Samir (SRE): final quick log excerpt before handoff:
```
2026-03-15T09:52:00Z controller: provision_attempt id=894 accepted (manual-create)
2026-03-15T09:53:10Z node: kubelet ready: node=node-342-temp-pool
2026-03-15T09:54:30Z routing: policy c-77 pref=hosted fallback=true applied
```

Customer Support: updating ticket and will schedule customer call first thing local business hours.

Ava (oncall): incident severity set to Sev2; moving to monitoring + customer coordination. Handoff notes posted to #incidents-runbooks.

Priya (Platform): follow-ups created: [PLAT-342] image mirror for c-77, [PLAT-343] registry TLS validation checks, [INFRA-780] autoscaler limit feature flag review.

Jordan (Infra): thumbs up. Leaving oncall contact: @Jordan (Infra).

PagerDuty Bot: incident acknowledged by Jordan (Infra).
